descriptions.RS54: This smells like a creamy version of Zkittlez to me. It has that “sweet zkittlez” smell but with an extra creamy twist to it. Nice middle of the road hybrid effects.
descriptions.Sherb Stack: Unreal bag appeal with that unmistakable funky, yet gassy Sherb profile. It definitely leans on the Sunset Sherbet side of the cross with potent, slightly indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Don Mega: We usually do organic soil runs of this since it can be really finicky, but this batch might be the best one yet. Reeks of GMO and old school Kush/OG with Indica dominant effects.
descriptions.Maui Wowie 2.0: Bred by Sticky Finger Seeds, this is a Sativa lovers dream. The nose is very “tropical” smelling with ripe pineapple dominating with a little bit of overripe banana as well as a hint of peppery haze mixed in. Very mentally stimulating sativa effects.
descriptions.Blue Star Moonshine: Intense nose on this – 10/10 in the smell department. This reeks like a fresh blueberry pie. Last batch was greenhouse, but this indoor batch is very dialed in. Potent slightly sativa leaning effects. This is machine trimmed instead of hand trimmed so it is slightly discounted.
descriptions.Headband: This has that leathery, slightly musty, burnt tire terp profile going on – very similar to something like Marathon OG. Very authentic headband terps that lean more on the funky OG side. Nice chunky nugs that are slightly discounted to being machine trimmed this round.
descriptions.Blueberry Lemon Shake-Up: This is one of those don’t judge a book by its cover strains – it doesn’t look like anything special(slightly discounted due to bag appeal) but the effects and terps are 10/10. Similar smell to the Blue Star Moonshine but with a zesty lemon twist to it. Very sativa dominant effects that can be slightly on the racy side. This is the last drop of Blue Star / Blueberry strains for a while.
descriptions.Gelato 41 x Coffin Candy: Although this doesn’t have an official name from the Doja release, people refer to it as “41 coffins”. Very dank, gas heavy gelato smell with a hint of sherb funk going on in the background. Potent indica leaning effects. Diesel Burger (Sour Diesel x Donny Burger) – This one is special in my opinion. Very strong nose and effects that lean ever so slightly on the Sativa side. You can definitely smell the donny burger/GMO in this but it has this Diesel funk going on in the background. It smells like 70% GMO, 30% Sour Diesel to me. Sherb Star (Sherb Cake x Blue Star) – This leans heavy on the Sherb Cake side with an almost obnoxiously stinky sherb funk profile. Potent indica leaning effects. This is machine trimmed instead of hand trimmed so it is slightly discounted.
descriptions.Diesel Burger: This one is special in my opinion. Very strong nose and effects that lean ever so slightly on the Sativa side. You can definitely smell the donny burger/GMO in this but it has this Diesel funk going on in the background. It smells like 70% GMO, 30% Sour Diesel to me. Sherb Star (Sherb Cake x Blue Star) – This leans heavy on the Sherb Cake side with an almost obnoxiously stinky sherb funk profile. Potent indica leaning effects. This is machine trimmed instead of hand trimmed so it is slightly discounted.
descriptions.Lava Cake: Sweet and creamy, the Thin Mint GSC really shines through on this with heavy “cake/cookie” terps with a hint of sweetness from the Grape Pie. Indica leaning hybrid effects.
descriptions.Glueberry OG: Amazing smell on this – you can smell a little of every strain in here. It leans most on the Blueberry side with a kush/GG backend. This surprisingly smoked like a Sativa leaning hybrid for me personally.

blueberry-chem-23-chem-dominant-pheno-th.title: Blueberry Chem #23 (Chem Dominant Pheno) THCa Flower

blueberry-chem-7-blueberry-pheno-thca-fl.title: Blueberry Chem #7 (Blueberry Dominant Pheno) THCa Flower

descriptions.Neon: Interesting nose on this. It has this funky truffle/GMO profile going on with some sweetness in the background. Potent Indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Eye Candy: This has that creamy, yet gassy biscotti smell but with an extra sweet kushy twist from the Menthol. Potent Indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Biscotti Pancakes: Interesting nose on this. It kind of has this sweet GMO funk going on with a creamy vanilla like undertones. Potent Indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Silky Gelato: Classic Gelato smell but with just a hint of gassy pine terps in there. I’m not personally a huge gelato fan but I’ve been enjoying this one. Nice middle of the road hybrid effects.
descriptions.Tamalez: Complex nose on this. It smells like a more sweet/creamy version of Presidential OG. You can still smell the Runtz, but it leans more heavy on the sweet, creamy kush side with potent indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Blue Sherbet: Interesting nose on this. It has some of that gassy sherb funk going on but with a sweet creamy kush thing going on as well. Indica dominant effects.
descriptions.Cherry Marker: Strong nose on this, it actually smells like a cherry scented permanent marker. The cherry from the LCG really comes through with a strong “permanent marker” funk going on as well with indica leaning hybrid effects.
descriptions.Dog Star Blue Axis: Straight old school Chem right here. This is a special breeding project by Blue Star Seed Co – “Dog Star is a focused exploration of Blueberry lineage meeting raw Chem 91 fuel, created as a true reciprocal pairing to examine maternal influence and terpene dominance. The Blue Axis tends to express brighter, sharper top notes — sour lime, sulfurous diesel, and penetrating fuel layered over dark berry undertones. This smoked like a potent Sativa to me, being a bit racy at times.
descriptions.Coffin Candy: 10/10 nose on this. Not the prettiest but this just reeks like Runtz with a skunk like twist to it. Super potent Indica dominant effects, this really put me out for the night.
descriptions.Staten Island Chem: – This is a very unique strain with a LOT of controversy surrounded its genetics/lineage. All I can comment on is it was bred/released via Stoney/Katsu seeds – this is the S2 version and has that chemical like chemdawg terp profile going on. The nose right off the bat is that “chem” smell, similar to something like SFV OG, but when ground up it turns into raunchy diesel/sour tones. Chunky, yet fluffy nugs with long lasting Sativa dominant effects, but not racy at all. DJ Short Flo (Purple Thai x Afghani Indica) – This has a very old school, musky, hash like smell/taste to it. Described by DJ Short as smelling like “musky/burgundy/floral” I would say that is spot on. Very unique effects, this is the definition of a “feel good” strain. Up beat, Sativa dominant effects perfect for a day time smoke.
descriptions.Trainwreck: – Another old school classic. This has that textbook high terpinolene train wreck smell with a hint of lemony pine thrown in. Potent sativa effects, this is a perfect anytime of day smoke. DJ Short Flo (Purple Thai x Afghani Indica) – This has a very old school, musky, hash like smell/taste to it. Described by DJ Short as smelling like “musky/burgundy/floral” I would say that is spot on. Very unique effects, this is the definition of a “feel good” strain. Up beat, Sativa dominant effects perfect for a day time smoke.
descriptions.Airheadz: – Classic runtz profile on this. It leans a little more on the candy side of candy gas. Nice middle of the road hybrid effects.
descriptions.Georgia Pie x Zkittlez: Strong nose on this, has a gassy, almost Sherb like smell at first that becomes more sweet and “zkittlez” like when ground up. Potent middle of the road hybrid effects.
descriptions.Mac N Jack: The bud structure on this is heavy on the MAC side, but the smell and effects are almost all Jack. It has that textbook “Jack” smell but the MAC helps with the effects to give it some more body than pure Jack Herer. Still leans on the Sativa side effects wise and is a nice anytime of day smoke.
descriptions.Bluemosa: This defiantly leans on the mimosa side with that zesty tangerine profile coming through with some kushy creaminess on the backend form the blue cookies. Nice sativa leaning hybrid effects
descriptions.Marathon OG: This is for the OG lovers. If you prefer your OG to lean more on the gassy/chemmy side instead of piney/earthy you will absolutely love this. It has a hint of skunky lemon going on in the background as well. Potent Indica leaning effects.
descriptions.Subzero: This leans more on the Oreoz side with that earthy, yet sweet and creamy terp profile going on. Nice middle of the road hybrid effects that lean on the Indica side ever so slightly. Blue Lobster (Apples N Bananas x Eye Candy) (SMALLS ONLY) – Sweet yet gassy, it kind of reminds me of a sweeter version of gelato, but still has that “candy gas” terp profile going on. Nice middle of the road hybrid effects.
descriptions.Platinum Truffles: You can definitely smell the truffle in this but it has a solid OG backend to it. Indica leaning hybrid effects.
